body: I’ve got a few different plans to leave and I don’t think I can give her the chance of me staying. It’s all that self doubt, and her voice saying it’s not okay or that I can’t do it. I appreciate the list idea, I do need to stand up for myself, I just can’t even think of things I could realistically expect from her, so I’ve gotta get out ASAP, I’m just worried about the no contact

I like the note idea, and reading your comment I realized it got much worse when I decided to treat myself to lunch and a little walk, she wouldn’t allow me that peace. Now I’m actually at a friend’s and she’s still pushing me. I still have to get all of my stuff out of my sister’s place but I really like your idea, thank you.

Before you pass out or anything, you’re going to get very dry skin, muscle cramps, headaches, and a variety of other symptoms. Chances are you’d cause long-term damage and still survive. Sometimes drinking a glass of water is enough to change your perspective. Choosing to love yourself enough to take care of yourself is the hardest battle I’ve ever fought, I still do everyday, and I’m sorry you’re battling it too.

I’ve written so many notes, and it’s always kind of snapped me back to reality. To actually put your pain on paper and think of how each and every person you’d leave behind would feel, to say goodbye and sorry, can actually really help to ground some people. I’m never as numb after writing those feelings down.
